questions.question_text:
How many bookings were made on Wednesday?
$\begin{array}{c|rrrr}\text{Day}&\text{Mon}&\text{Tue}&\text{Wed}&\text{Thu}\\\hline\text{Bookings}&42&38&51&47\end{array}$

options.why: Reads the Tuesday value instead of the Wednesday value.
Reads the Thursday value instead of the Wednesday value.
Adds all four days instead of reading the requested single value.

questions.question_text:
Find the total number of workshop places.
$\begin{array}{c|rrrr}\text{Workshop}&A&B&C&D\\\hline\text{Places}&16&24&18&22\end{array}$

options.why: Adds only three values and omits Workshop A.
Adds only the first two workshop values.
Reports the largest single value instead of the total.
Reads the Central bar instead of the South bar.
Reads the North bar instead of the South bar.
Reports the number of grid steps and ignores the scale of 15.

questions.solution_text: The South bar reaches the label $75$.

options.why: Chooses the shortest bar instead of the tallest bar.
Reads Team C's bar, which reaches $24$, instead of the tallest bar, which reaches $40$.
Chooses the last team on the horizontal axis instead of the team with the tallest bar.

questions.solution_text:
Team B has the tallest bar, reaching $40$ cases.
Team B completed the most cases.

questions.question_text:
The total is $200$.
Find the missing value.
$\begin{array}{c|rrrr}\text{Zone}&A&B&C&D\\\hline\text{Requests}&48&57&39&?\end{array}$

options.why: Finds the subtotal of known values but does not subtract it from 200.
Adds the known subtotal to 200 instead of finding the missing part.

questions.question_text:
The table shows parcels delivered by four routes.
How many more parcels did Route B deliver than Route D?
$\begin{array}{c|rrrr}\text{Route}&A&B&C&D\\\hline\text{Parcels}&128&173&146&89\end{array}$

options.why: Adds the two requested values: $173+89=262$, instead of finding their difference.
Compares Route B with Route C instead of Route D: $173-146=27$.
Compares Route A with Route D instead of Route B with Route D: $128-89=39$.

questions.solution_text:
Read the values for Routes B and D.
$173-89$
$=84\text{ parcels}$
